mapper.sql: SELECT I.INVITATION_ID, I.PLAN_ID, I.INVITER_MEMBER_ID, I.INVITEE_MEMBER_ID, I.INVITEE_EMAIL, I.INVITATION_STATUS, I.EXPIRES_AT, P.TITLE AS PLAN_TITLE, R.REGION_NAME, P.START_DATE, P.END_DATE FROM PLAN_INVITATION I JOIN TRAVEL_PLAN P ON P.PLAN_ID = I.PLAN_ID JOIN REGION_MASTER R ON R.REGION_CODE = P.REGION_CODE WHERE I.INVITATION_TOKEN = #{tokenHash} AND P.PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLAN_INVITATION ( INVITATION_ID, PLAN_ID, INVITER_MEMBER_ID, INVITEE_MEMBER_ID, INVITEE_EMAIL, INVITATION_STATUS, INVITATION_TOKEN, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{invitationId}, #{planId}, #{inviterMemberId}, #{inviteeMemberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{inviteeEmail}, #{status}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt} )
